channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Gaza holds mass funeral for 112 people killed in Israel’s 2023 Sabra attack
item.description: Thousands join to bury remains after they were recovered from rubble of homes destroyed during Israel’s genocidal war.

item.title: War on Iran: Trump says Iran has one ‘last chance’
item.description: US President Donald Trump says Iran has ‘one last chance’ to make a deal, but Tehran is in no hurry to take it.

item.title: Qatar says indirect talks continue to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Qatar FM spokesman Dr. Majed al-Ansari says indirect talks are continuing to avoid further regional escalation.

item.title: Why are oil companies posting record profits amid Iran war disruption?
item.description: Big Oil companies have bagged astronomical profits as the critical Strait of Hormuz remains closed.

item.title: Mass funeral in Gaza for 112 Palestinians killed in 2023 Israeli strike
item.description: The bodies - belonging to members of two extended families - have only recently been recovered from under rubble in Gaza City.

item.title: Threat to oil tankers in Middle East worst since start of Iran war, analysts say
item.description: Fresh attacks on alternative shipping routes have left tankers facing an increasingly complex situation, analysts say.

item.title: Did Iran hack water systems in seven US states?
item.description: While US President Donald Trump has said Iran is not to blame, cyber experts tell the BBC it likely the attack was at the hands of the Iran.

item.title: At the scene of deadly Moscow bomb blast
item.description: Three people have been killed and 21 injured after an explosive device detonated at an Italian restaurant, Russian media reports.
